summary: APM on c097_nic is dropping 1.07% of packets at its capture interface (421,380 discards on APM eth1) because the tool cannot keep up; link is healthy but APM visibility is degraded.

findings.root_cause: APM eth1 NIC/capture pipeline is oversubscribed and discarding packets after delivery from packet broker. 1.07% loss (421,380 packets) exceeds 0.1% threshold - this is tool-side overload, not network/path loss.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM sees incomplete transactions and flows, misses application latency/errors, inflates retransmission counts and breaks end-to-end timing correlation

recommended_fix.why: Drops occur at the APM's own interface after successful delivery, so broker tuning alone won't help. Reduce load per tool (load-balance across APM instances, filter irrelevant traffic, or slice payload - APM needs_full_payload=false) or upgrade APM capture capacity/ring buffers.
